name: orichalcum
lore_descriptor: copper-rose flickering to bronze when shadowed
first_pickup_chronicle: Orichalcum. Atlantis was real, then. Or my memory of it just became real. The metal is warm to the touch and hums when held near a spell. Plato saw one of these once. He didn't believe it either.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.60, weight_mult 0.95, effective_against outsider+demon_major (T5 specialty). Deliberately narrow spawn spread (6) — orichalcum is rare-of-rares. armor_ac_bonus 2 and max_enchant 7 (highest of any material) put it above shadowiron for magical builds. spell_damage_bonus_15pct stacks with the player's wand/spell damage.
